messages:
Ashley (sales): Prospect wants BYO-HSM with an offline key ceremony option and clear pricing for rotation frequency (daily/weekly/monthly). They also want attestation artifacts for procurement. Keep it short for legal.
Diego (solutions): Offline ceremony adds logistics: remote witness or on-site, key-splitting tools, and a short runbook. For POC we can simulate a ceremony (ephemeral KEK) to prove flow without full attestation.
Faye (crypto): For attestation: we can provide HSM model certs (FIPS), vendor attestation PDFs, and a hashed audit trail from our side. If they need vendor presence, that's an add-on in SOW.
Ben (platform): Billing: two buckets 1) fixed onboarding/attestation fee (covers workspace, audit collection, and one ceremony) and 2) per-unwrap ops. Example: onboarding $5k, unwrap ops ~0.2$ per 1k unwraps in best-case (same-region). Rotation frequency impacts ops: daily rotate increases wrap/unwarp volume (we should show % increase).
Ashley (sales): Can we quantify rotation impact for procurement? They requested a simple table like "monthly = baseline, weekly = +X%, daily = +Y%".
Diego (solutions): Rough rule-of-thumb: each rotation requires re-wrapping active DEKs once. For workloads dominated by steady inference, weekly rotation ~+5%-10% unwraps; daily could be +40%-60% depending on active-key churn. We'll put ranges and label as POC-validate.
Faye (crypto): Security note: if customer mandates zero-cache (no DEK caching), cost and latency both increase significantly. Document fallback: short TTL cache (1-5m) as compromise. Include revocation playbook and key destroy checklist for legal.
Ben (platform): Network: outbound 443 to their KMS/HSM gateway. If they require air-gapped HSM, we need an ops tunnel or a vended appliance; that'll be in SOW.
ops-bot: Ticket created #SUP-4512 assigned Diego (solutions)  deliverables: 1-page attestation pack, rotation-cost table, sample ceremony runbook  due in 72h.
Ashley (sales): Action items: Diego -> one-pager + sample runbook; Ben -> rotation cost calc + network note; Faye -> attestation docs and revocation playbook. I'll package and send to procurement. Thanks :thumbsup:
